dedupe_keys.name: zensus 2022 grid data buildings and dwellings in 100 m 1 km and 10 km cells germany

description: Germany's 2022 census publishes its results on a regular statistical grid, so building and housing characteristics can be mapped independently of administrative units. The Destatis census page offers 51 topic ZIP archives, each holding CSV files for the 10 km, 1 km and 100 m grids plus an Excel dataset description. Building and housing topics include buildings with living space by construction year (decades and census classes), building type and size, number of dwellings, predominant heating type and heating energy carrier, ownership form, vacancy and market vacancy rates, average net rent, dwelling floor area and rooms, and owner-occupier share; population topics sit alongside. Coverage: all of Germany at the census day, 15 May 2022. Access: free ZIP downloads, a map atlas and the Zensus database. Licence: Data licence Germany attribution 2.0. Caveats: most building topics cover buildings with living space only, and the combined table of buildings by construction year, type and energy is offered only for the 1 km grid. Simulation uses are gridded building age, heating and vacancy layers for heat planning, hazard exposure and retrofit models. Related records: the Germany building types map and the official LoD2 3D building model.
